description: This file contains kernel fatal error handling functions for Zephyr RTOS, including system halt, fatal error handler, and error reporting logic.

methods.name: arch_system_halt
methods.description: Weak function to halt the system, spins endlessly.

methods.name: k_sys_fatal_error_handler
methods.description: Weak function to handle fatal errors, logs panic and halts system.

methods.description: Retrieves thread name or returns 'unknown' if not available.

methods.description: Converts error reason code to string description.

methods.description: Function to halt system with a given reason.
